about: Probes for the Bolt gateway's Apache AGE backend (bolt/README.md, 'In front of Apache AGE'). Each probe sends the plain form straight to AGE, without the gateway's rewrite. See README.md here.

probes.rewrite: a SET after a MERGE that has ON CREATE/ON MATCH items → cut into several statements in one transaction: the MERGE ends one, the SET runs as the next (split.rs)

MATCH (n:L {k: 1}) RETURN n.a, n.b

probes.note: The statement's own row shows b = 2; the stored vertex has no b.

MATCH (n:L {k: 1}) RETURN n.a, n.e

probes.rewrite: (no rewrite) AGE's graph version counter table has 128 slots that drop_graph does not free; after that every Cypher write warns and the VLE cache falls back to snapshots
probes.source: SUITES §5 N11 (WARNING:  AGE: graph version counter table full (128 graphs))
probe: DO $do$ DECLARE g text; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..130 LOOP g := 'agp_n11_' || i; PERFORM ag_catalog.create_graph(g::name); EXECUTE format('SELECT * FROM ag_catalog.cypher(%L, $cy$ CREATE (:V {k: 1}) $cy$) AS (a ag_catalog.agtype)', g); PERFORM ag_catalog.drop_graph(g::name, true); COMMIT; END LOOP; END $do$

probe.cypher: CREATE (:V {k: 1})

cleanup: SELECT ag_catalog.drop_graph(name, true) FROM ag_catalog.ag_graph WHERE name::text LIKE 'agp\_n11\_%'
probes.note: Makes and drops 130 graphs, one transaction each (the COMMIT keeps the lock table small). Leaves the server's 128 slots full until it restarts (every later Cypher write warns), so it runs after every other non-crashing probe and only with --include-slow. AGE master frees the slot on drop (release_graph_version()) and has 256.

probe: SELECT c.relname::text, l.name::text, l.kind::text, x.indisunique::text, x.indisvalid::text, pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(x.indexrelid, k, true) FROM ag_catalog.ag_label l JOIN ag_catalog.ag_graph g ON g.graphid = l.graph JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index x ON x.indrelid = l.relation::oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = x.indexrelid CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.generate_series(1, x.indnkeyatts::int) AS k WHERE g.name = '@graph@' AND x.indexprs IS NOT NULL AND l.name NOT IN ('_ag_label_vertex', '_ag_label_edge') ORDER BY c.relname, k
probes.note: The SQL of procs.rs indexes_sql less the oid column. The form pg_get_indexdef prints was inferred, not seen.

probe.cypher: MATCH (n:V {k: 0}) CALL apoc.neighbors.tohop(n, '>', 2) YIELD node AS m RETURN m.k ORDER BY m.k

probes.rewrite: CALL apoc.neighbors.tohop(n, '>', d) YIELD node AS m → MATCH (n)-[*1..d]->(m) WHERE id(m) <> id(n) WITH DISTINCT …, m (procs.rs tohop): each reached node once, the start left out

probe.cypher: MATCH (n:V {k: 0}) MATCH (n)-[*1..2]->(m) WHERE id(m) <> id(n) WITH DISTINCT n, m RETURN m.k ORDER BY m.k

probes.note: k2 is reached over two trails and k0 over a closed one; the DISTINCT and the id test leave k1, k2.
